chars.SALAH: SALAH: a skinny young man wearing a cement-dusted faded red t-shirt, grey work trousers and black rubber boots.
chars.HAJ MOHAMED: HAJ MOHAMED: a chubby older man with a short grey beard, a white knitted taqiya cap, a cream short-sleeve shirt, beige trousers and a gold watch.
chars.HIBA: HIBA: a young woman with small gold hoop earrings, a lilac oversized hoodie, white wide-leg jeans and white sneakers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Courtyard of an unfinished luxury villa in a Moroccan city with an empty swimming pool, cement bags and tiles around. HAJ MOHAMED walks in proudly with his daughter HIBA. SALAH, holding a bucket of cement, freezes in shock, mouth open. HIBA stares straight at him with a raised eyebrow and a suspicious half-smile. Comic awkward tension between the two young people.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the unfinished villa, HAJ MOHAMED suddenly answers his phone with a worried face, already walking toward the exit, pointing back at SALAH with his other hand. SALAH stands confused next to a pile of floor tiles.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At the villa gate, HAJ MOHAMED hands a few banknotes to his daughter HIBA in a hurry while opening the door of his white Mercedes. HIBA takes the money, glancing back over her shoulder toward the villa.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HAJ MOHAMED, leaning out of his car window, points at SALAH who stands in the background in the villa courtyard, telling HIBA to wait with him. SALAH looks nervous and gulps, HIBA smiles mischievously.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SALAH alone in the villa, kneeling and laying floor tiles, sweating, glancing nervously at the gate. A wall clock above shows the time passing. Bright Moroccan afternoon light, empty pool behind him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HIBA comes back holding a paper bag of msemen and two glasses of mint tea, and sits down very close to SALAH on the cement steps of the villa. SALAH stiffens awkwardly, covered in cement dust, not knowing where to look.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close two-shot on the cement steps of the villa: HIBA turns to SALAH and points her finger at him with narrowed eyes and a teasing smile, as if she just recognized him. SALAH sweats, eyes wide, frozen with a guilty grin.
